questions.stem_text: With industrial capitalism, leisure emerged as a concept that meant:

options.A: distinct periods of non-work and relaxation
options.B: regulated and organized activities to reduce social disorder
options.C: the growth of civic, municipal culture through public libraries, museums and art galleries

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - all of the above

questions.stem_text: Equilibrium theories of social change emphasize

options.B: stability and the structure of society

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - stability and the structure of society

questions.stem_text: In their study of depression, Brown & Harris (1978) found that:

options.A: women's susceptibility to stress depended on their levels of social support
options.B: self-reported depression is highest amongst men and the relatively affluent
options.C: men and women have fairly similar levels of diagnosed depression
options.D: men are more vulnerable to depression because of conventional gender roles

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - women's susceptibility to stress depended on their levels of social support

questions.stem_text: Which of the following is the most important agent of socialization in early childhood?
The media-themes model of media influence claims that:

options.A: audiences selectively interpret what they want to hear
options.B: content analysis is the best way to identify the themes covered by the media
options.C: audiences passively absorb whatever messages they are given
options.D: social interaction reinforces the ideas and images that audiences select

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - social interaction reinforces the ideas and images that audiences select
